2. Facts, relevant for disposal of this Rule, in brief, are that, Md Nozib Uddin alias Nazim had filed a Miscellaneous Case No. 27 of 2005, before the court of Senior Assistant Judge, Sujanagar, Pabna, against Md Mukul Mondal and 2 others under section 96(1) of the State Acquisition & Tenancy Act, 1950, seeking pre-emption in respect of the suit property. The claim of the petitioner's is that, he is co-sharer in the suit property comprising 0.073/4 acres of land lying at RS Plot Nos. 3526, 3527, 3528 and 3529 of Mouja Borojorpukuria, PS Sujanagar, District-Pabna, and further claimed that, the deed of exchange No.2769, dated 28-6-2005, on the basis of which the pre-emptee No.1 Mukul Mondol obtained title at suit property, is not in substance a sale deed and that the pre-emptor No.1 is a stranger of the suit property. 

 3. The pre-emptor-petitioner has adduced 2 witnesses as PWs and also proved certain documents marked as Exhibits-1 to 3, to support his case. On the other hand, the pre-emptee No.1 has contested in the suit by filing written objection, in which he has denied all material allegations made in the plaint and stated his case at paragraph-7 of the written statement. The pre-emptee has also adduced 2 OPWs and proved certain documents to support his case.
